nodes.name: Load Exact Analytics Operations and Contract

parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json, min=Number(x.metric_contract.minimum_views||0); const grouped={},low=[]; for(const r of x.analytics){const views=Number(r.views),completed=Number(r.completed_views),saves=Number(r.saves); if(views<min){low.push(r.video_id); continue;} const g=grouped[r.hook_family]??={hook_family:r.hook_family,video_count:0,total_views:0,completed_views:0,saves:0}; g.video_count++; g.total_views+=views; g.completed_views+=completed; g.saves+=saves;} const summary=Object.values(grouped).map(g=>({...g,completion_rate:Number((g.completed_views/g.total_views).toFixed(4)),save_rate:Number((g.saves/g.total_views).toFixed(4))})); const accepted=x.operations.filter(r=>r.accepted_status==='accepted'),pilot=x.operations.filter(r=>r.phase==='pilot'),baseline=x.operations.filter(r=>r.phase==='baseline'); const totalCost=x.operations.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.cost_sgd),0),acceptedCost=Number((totalCost/accepted.length).toFixed(2)); const blockers=x.operations.filter(r=>Number(r.unresolved_rights_items)>0||Number(r.blocking_review_findings)>0); const rollbackOk=x.operations.every(r=>r.rollback_tested==='true'); const duplicateReleaseActions=x.operations.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.duplicate_release_actions||0),0); const capacityOk=x.operations.every(r=>Number(r.human_review_capacity_slots)>=Number(r.human_reviews_required)); const avg=(rows,field)=>Number((rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r[field]),0)/rows.length).toFixed(2)); return [{json:{run_id:'HB-001',status:'analysis_ready',metric_contract_version:x.metric_contract.version||'metric-v1',summary_by_hook:summary,low_volume_video_ids:low,operations:{job_count:x.operations.length,accepted_count:accepted.length,cost_per_accepted_video_sgd:acceptedCost,baseline_cycle_minutes:avg(baseline,'cycle_minutes'),pilot_cycle_minutes:avg(pilot,'cycle_minutes'),blocking_job_ids:blockers.map(r=>r.job_id),duplicate_release_actions:duplicateReleaseActions,rollback_all_tested:rollbackOk,human_review_capacity_sufficient:capacityOk},recommended_scale_decision:(blockers.length||!capacityOk||!rollbackOk||duplicateReleaseActions>0)?'HOLD':'PILOT',caveats:[`Rows below minimum_views=${min} were excluded from grouped results: ${low.join(', ')||'none'}.`,'Synthetic training data cannot establish future causal performance.'],external_action_count:0}}];
